Cartoon Network - Punch Time Explosion.name: Cartoon Network: Punch Time Explosion
Cartoon Network - Punch Time Explosion.summary: This Cartoon Network Fighter is a crossover fighting game featuring the stars of Ben 10, Dexter's Laboratory, PowerPuff Girls, and more.

Power Rangers Super Megaforce.name: Power Rangers Super Megaforce
Power Rangers Super Megaforce.summary: Power Rangers: Super Megaforce is a 2014 video game based on the twenty-first season of the popular American incarnation of the tokusatsu series.

Shinrei Camera - Tsuiteru Techou.name: Spirit Camera: The Cursed Memoir
Shinrei Camera - Tsuiteru Techou.summary: Spirit Camera: The Cursed Memoir introduces a mysterious girl named Maya who has been hiding in the shadows of an old house. Players must help Maya break free from a terrifying curse by aiding her escape from the clutches of a malevolent woman in black. By using the Nintendo 3DS system's built-in camera, players can view Maya in their own surroundings as the game's eerie events unfold.

Tetsudou Nippon! Rosen Tabi - Aizu Tetsu.name: Tetsudou Nippon! Rosen Tabi: Aizu Tetsudou‑hen
Tetsudou Nippon! Rosen Tabi - Aizu Tetsu.summary:
A train simulation game from Sonic Powered's "Japanese Rail Sim" series. This title is exclusive to Japan, and was the last game in the series released for the Nintendo 3DS.
In this entry, you can operate the Aizu Railway's "AT-700" and "AT-100" train models through a 57.4 km trip from Nishiwakamatsu Station to Aizu Kogen Ozeguchi Station, on Aizu Railway's Aizu Line.
